schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus a category field. Tier A only: these observe whether the terminal consults the skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomized per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration. No held-out query appears in SKILL.md.
negative_note: Each negative names the sibling that owns the request. Several of those siblings are specified but not implemented, which does not weaken the negative: the requirement is that devforge-plan is not consulted, and it can be observed independently of whether a routing target exists. Do not install a stub to obtain a routing result.
status_note: NOT_RUN. Authored queries only; no terminal observation exists for this package.
